# ChatPromptGenius

> > ChatPromptGenius is a comprehensive resource for AI prompt engineering, offering free and premium prompts, guides, and tools for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI platforms.

The site provides practical prompt libraries, optimization techniques, and industry-specific applications across real estate, marketing, and research. ChatPromptGenius helps users master prompt engineering through interactive courses, troubleshooting guides, and career resources for working with GPT-4, Claude (Anthropic), and other language models.

## Getting Started

- [How It Works](https://chatpromptgenius.com/how-it-works): Explains ChatPromptGenius AI prompt tools, GPTs, and purchase process
- [Free Prompts](https://chatpromptgenius.com/free-prompts): Free AI prompt library for ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini with instant downloads
- [How to Choose the Right GPT or Prompt for Your Goals](https://chatpromptgenius.com/choose-the-right-gpt): Guide to selecting appropriate GPT models and prompts for specific goals

## Prompt Engineering Fundamentals

- [How to Use Prompts on Any AI Platform – Not Just ChatGPT](https://chatpromptgenius.com/how-to-use-prompts-on-any-ai-platform): Universal prompting guide for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other platforms
- [Common ChatGPT Prompt Mistakes: How to Troubleshoot, Optimize, and Improve Accuracy](https://chatpromptgenius.com/common-chatgpt-prompt-mistakes): Guide to troubleshooting ChatGPT prompt mistakes and optimization techniques
- [Prompt Engineering Interactive Courses: Your Ultimate Guide to Mastering AI Communication Skills](https://chatpromptgenius.com/prompt-engineering-interactive-courses): Comprehensive guide to interactive prompt engineering courses and training

## Advanced Techniques
